content:
My Zulip Windows client is connected to 16 organizations, and I'd like to reorder them: for example Lean is at the very top while an important org I just joined is at the bottom, and I'd like to have them on the same screen to easily check messages from both.

Settings->Organizations allows me to disconnect from an organization, and presumably I can disconnect from the Lean org and reconnect, but I'm worried that my draft messages might be lost after disconnection, as they don't persist across clients. If this is not an unnecessary worry, could you implement organization reordering by dragging?

Removing and re-adding orgs in the Desktop app settings is the way, currently. Others have requested the same drag-to-reorder feature over the years, and it's tracked at: https://github.com/zulip/zulip-desktop/issues/548. I'm adding your request to that list!

I did a little spot test: logged out of an org, removed it from the organization list in my Desktop app (iOS), quit and then restarted Zulip Desktop, logged back into the org. My drafts were all still there.

I can ask for a Zulip engineer to verify how/where the drafts are being saved, to confirm that there isn't a risk of losing them by removing/readding orgs in Desktop. Especially since I'm not on the same exact app, I would hate to tell you it's safe and then have it turn out otherwise.
Cross-posted at https://chat.zulip.org/#narrow/channel/16-desktop/topic/does.20re-ordering.20organizations.20risk.20losing.20drafts.3F/with/2502410

Confirmed, you're safe to disconnect and reconnect your organizations!

@_Anders Kaseorg|699 said:

Correct. Zulip Desktop has only one browser session, and the frontend stores drafts in that browser session’s localStorage. Disconnecting and reconnecting an organization doesn’t affect that browser session; it’s the equivalent of closing and opening a tab in your web browser.
Thanks for the confirmation! Tested and indeed the drafts are safe.
